en: Colorized view of a harbor at sunset with a stone breakwater leading to a small lighthouse. Calm water, a signal mast on the left, and a few figures on the pier. Caption printed in red at the bottom left. Handwritten notes appear along the right margin of the image and across the back. The reverse side reads "BREFKORT / Carte postale" with an address to a villa in Lundsbrunn.
